# Sheriyakam — Complete Service & Technical Knowledge Dossier

## 1. Company Information
- **Brand Name**: Sheriyakam
- **Tagline**: Professional Service Booking Platform in Kerala
- **Primary Domain**: https://sheriyakam.vercel.app
- **HQ / Hub**: Thalassery, Kannur, Kerala 670101, India
- **Customer Support Phone**: +91 98765 43210
- **Support Email**: support@sheriyakam.com
- **Operating Hours**: 24/7/365 Emergency Dispatch, 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM General Service

## 2. Executive Summary & Value Proposition
Sheriyakam is Kerala's fastest-growing electrical and home technology service platform. We solve the friction of finding reliable, background-checked, and government-certified electricians in Kerala. Users can book in under 60 seconds with transparent base rates, GPS tracking of arriving technicians, OTP-verified job completion, and a ₹5,00,000 domestic safety guarantee.

## 3. Detailed Service Offerings & Pricing Structure

### 3.1 Emergency Electrical Repair Specialist
- **Base Rate**: ₹550
- **Turnaround Time**: Under 90 minutes emergency on-site response.
- **Scope**: Total power outage diagnosis, short circuit resolution, burning wire smell investigation, fuse blown repairs, phase failure checks.
- **Includes**: Safety hazard isolation, voltage testing, temporary or permanent circuit restoration.

### 3.2 Fan Repair & Installation
- **Base Rate**: ₹350
- **Scope**: Ceiling fan balancing, capacitor replacement, bearing noise repair, BLDC smart fan installation, exhaust fan mounting.

### 3.3 Complete Home & Office Electrical Wiring
- **Base Rate**: ₹550 (Labour/point-based pricing provided on inspection)
- **Scope**: Concealed conduit wiring, open surface casing, switchboard point additions, earthing pit installation (GI/Copper), 3-phase load balance.

### 3.4 Distribution Board (DB) & Switchgear Maintenance
- **Base Rate**: ₹450
- **Scope**: MCB (Miniature Circuit Breaker) replacement, RCCB/ELCB tripping diagnosis, isolator testing, busbar cleaning and tightening.

### 3.5 Inverter & UPS Services
- **Base Rate**: ₹500
- **Scope**: Inverter installation, dual-battery wiring, distilled water top-up, backup load optimization, charging fault repairs.

### 3.6 Air Conditioning (AC) Service & Maintenance
- **Base Rate**: ₹650
- **Scope**: Deep jet-wash coil cleaning, filter sterilization, refrigerant (R32/R410A) gas pressure checks, drain line unclogging, compressor capacitor swap.

### 3.7 CCTV Security Surveillance Setup
- **Base Rate**: ₹550
- **Scope**: HD & IP camera installation, DVR/NVR configuration, Cat6 crimping, hard drive setup, mobile remote monitoring configuration.

### 3.8 Smart Home Automation & IoT
- **Base Rate**: ₹500
- **Scope**: Smart WiFi touch switches, scene controllers, smart curtain relays, voice-assistant integration (Alexa & Google Assistant).

## 4. Quality & Safety Guarantees
- **Government Certification**: All electrical technicians hold valid wireman or electrical supervisor permits issued by the Kerala Electrical Inspectorate.
- **Background Checks**: Mandatory police record clearance and ID verification.
- **Damage Protection**: Up to ₹5,00,000 accidental domestic safety insurance on every confirmed booking.
- **Warranty**: 30-day rework warranty on all labor and service points.

## 6. Frequently Asked Quotable Questions

**Q: How much does an electrician cost in Kerala through Sheriyakam?**
A: Sheriyakam electrician services in Kerala start at a transparent base tariff of ₹350 for standard fan repairs, ₹450 for DB switchgear maintenance, and ₹550 for emergency short-circuit repairs, with itemized pricing confirmed prior to work.

**Q: How fast can an emergency electrician arrive in Kerala?**
A: Sheriyakam dispatches emergency electricians within 90 minutes across all major municipalities and panchayats in Kerala for critical faults, power blackouts, and electrical hazards.

**Q: Are Sheriyakam technicians licensed and insured?**
A: Yes, 100% of Sheriyakam technicians hold licenses certified by the Kerala Electrical Inspectorate and every job is backed by a ₹5,00,000 domestic safety protection cover and a 30-day rework warranty.
